HSK(7-9)

Level

7-9

The world's most popular Chinese language proficiency tests

HSK (Levels 7-9) are advanced proficiency levels intended for learners of Chinese as a second language. This includes international students pursuing master's and doctoral degrees in China, students majoring in Chinese in different countries, as well as professionals involved in academic research, economic, cultural, and technological exchanges conducted in Chinese.
Do A Mock
Book A Test
Test Structure
Vocabulary
Resources
HSK (Levels 7-9) These advanced levels evaluate a holistic range of skills, including listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation in Chinese. They encompass corresponding topics, tasks, grammar, and an extensive vocabulary of 11,000 Chinese words, while also delving into Chinese culture and the national conditions of China.
